title: Claim Settlement Terms by Tier: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)
content:
The claim terms of **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** set the loss-of-use (additional living expense) limit and period, the basis on which the dwelling and personal property loss above the attachment is measured, and the time standards of the claim file.

| Tier | Excess Flood 250K | Excess Flood 500K | Excess Flood 1M | Excess Flood 2M | Excess Flood 3M | Excess Flood 5M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Additional living expense limit, paid from the first dollar because NFIP primary policies carry none (USD per occurrence) | 25000 | 50000 | 75000 | 100000 | 150000 | 250000 |
| Longest period additional living expense is paid after the date of loss (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 18 | 24 | 24 |
| Dwelling loss measured above the attachment at | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| Personal property loss measured above the attachment at | actual cash value | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost | replacement cost |
| Signed proof of loss must be received within, after the date of loss (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Excess dwelling or personal property payment waits for the underlying settlement record | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Payment within, after the agreed proof of loss and the underlying settlement record (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Adjuster's first contact, Tidemark standard (elapsed hours) | 48 | 48 | 48 | 48 | 48 | 48 |
| Suit may be filed within, after the written denial (calendar months) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Either party may demand appraisal of the amount of loss | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

Only Excess Flood 250K measures personal property at actual cash value; every other tier measures it at replacement cost. Excess Flood 2M runs loss of use for up to 18 months, and Excess Flood 3M and 5M for up to 24.
